intro.title: Guess what we've been up to.

widget.title: Today's Tasks, Right on Your Home Screen
widget.body: Add the home-screen widget to see today's date and how many tasks you have at a glance. Chinese task names no longer get cut off.

invite-progress.title: Bring Your Friends In
invite-progress.body: Share your invite code — now you can see how many friends have joined, and how many more you need for the badge.

badge-unlock.title: Unlock a Badge, Wear It Right Away
badge-unlock.body: When you unlock a new badge, tap Equip reward in the popup and it shows on your profile.
